messages:
maria: Heads-up — prepping a geo-tailored bid experiment for the webinar week (May 6–10). Need search + retarget sync across NA/EU/APAC. Draft below, looking for quick alignment. :rocket:

maria: Plan (rough):
- Search: increase high-converting geo bids by +12% for top 10 zips per region
- Retargeting: 3 creative variants, separate frequency capping per region (NA 4/wk, EU 3/wk, APAC 3/wk)
- Budget pacing: soft cap for first 48h, then aggressive ramp if CTR>1.8%
- Measurement: 7-day post-click funnel + leads to SDR tag

maria: Config snippet (will apply in ad manager):
```
campaign: webinar_may_2024_geo_experiment
budget_daily: 12000
geo_overrides:
  NA: bid_multiplier: 1.12
  EU: bid_multiplier: 1.10
  APAC: bid_multiplier: 1.08
creative_rotations: [variantA, variantB, variantC]
```

ajay: Quick q — is the $12k/day the pooled account budget or targeted only to search? Need to confirm if retarget gets a separate carve.

sophia: I recommend carving 30% to retarget for the first 72h to seed high-intent users, then re-eval. Also suggest we swap creativeB with a short-form testimonial in NA. Link to variants: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/webinar-creatives (internal)

kevin: Please tag the retarget audience with lifecycle:mid-funnel and sdr:priority. For lookalike seeding, use the last 90d converters only. I can pull the LTV cohort if you want.

ajay: I can run the budget carve and apply geo overrides. Will do a dry run in staging first. Command I'll run (ad manager CLI):
```bash
rw-admanager apply --campaign webinar_may_2024_geo_experiment --env staging --confirm
```

growth-bot: Spend pulse: today $4,210 (12% under expected pacing). CTR baseline 1.5% (target 1.8%). Notifying channel for manual pacing tweaks.

maria: Perfect — ajay, please do staging dry run and post the logs. Kevin, sophia — can you share the creative assets by EOD PST? If we all land, we'll flip to prod at 09:00 PT on May 6. :thumbsup:

ajay: On it. Will post staging logs in this thread when done.

sophia: Sending assets now. I'll include the alt headlines for A/B.

kevin: LTV cohort exported and uploaded to shared drive: /marketing/exports/ltv_90d_may6.csv.

maria: Awesome — thanks everyone. We'll reconvene if staging shows any anomalies.
